description: Use this when someone asks when an animal is booked or what is booked on one day, including to move or cancel an appointment. Returns up to 100 appointments of one animal or one day, with id, animal, clinic and provider ids, times, status and edit time. Not for counting how busy each day is.

clinicId.description: Only appointments at this clinic, by an id from list_clinics; every clinic of the user's when absent

endTime.description: Only appointments ending before this ISO 8601 time

limit.description: Maximum number of appointments to return (default 20, maximum 100)

patientId.description: Only appointments of this animal, by an id from find_patient. Without it, give a window of one day.

startTime.description: Only appointments starting at or after this ISO 8601 time

name: list_appointments

appointments.description: Appointments, latest start first. Procedures, notes, reminders, owners and payments are excluded.

lastEditTime.description: Version to pass as expectedLastEditTime when moving or cancelling it

patientId.description: The animal, as a find_patient id

providerIds.description: Vets, nurses or assistants on it, as list_clinic_providers ids

title: List vet appointments
